dict.string: MacFileExplorer needs access to your Desktop folder to browse and manage your files.
MacFileExplorer needs access to your Documents folder to browse and manage your files.
MacFileExplorer needs access to your Downloads folder to browse and manage your files.
MacFileExplorer needs access to external volumes to display them in This PC.
MacFileExplorer uses System Audio capture only when you enable the Notch Equalizer to shape your music's frequencies in real time (never recorded or uploaded).
MacFileExplorer optionally reads your macOS Calendars when enabled in Notch Calendar settings to show upcoming events and meeting alerts.

MacFileExplorer uses Automation only when you trigger actions like revealing files in Finder, adjusting system volume, or controlling media playback from the Notch.
